questions: How should missing values (NaN) in numeric columns be handled? Should they be imputed, dropped, or left as NaN (which may cause errors in MinMaxScaler)?
Should the normalization be applied column-wise (per feature) or globally across all numeric columns?
Are datetime columns (which may be numeric internally) considered numeric and normalized, or left as is?
Should the function preserve the original column order, or might numeric columns be reordered after normalization?
If a numeric column contains only one unique value (e.g., all 5), should it be scaled to 0, 1, or left unchanged (to avoid division by zero)?
Should the function read the CSV with a specific encoding or delimiter, or assume default pandas behavior?
Are boolean columns (True/False) considered numeric and normalized, or left as is?
Should the function raise an error if the file does not exist or cannot be read, or handle it silently?
